verses.1:
Why do the nations rage + 2:1 Or noisily assemble ; see Revelation 11:18|REV 11:18 . 
 and the peoples plot in vain?
verses.2:
The kings of the earth take their stand
 and the rulers gather together,
 against the LORD
 and against His Anointed One: + 2:2 Cited in Acts 4:25–26|ACT 4:25-26
verses.3:
“Let us break Their chains
 and cast away Their cords.”
verses.4:
The One enthroned in heaven laughs;
 the Lord taunts them.
verses.5:
Then He rebukes them in His anger,
 and terrifies them in His fury:
verses.6:
“I have installed My King on Zion,
 upon My holy mountain.”
verses.7:
I will proclaim the decree
 spoken to Me by the LORD:
 “You are My Son;
 today I have become Your Father. + 2:7 Literally today I have begotten You ; cited in Acts 13:33|ACT 13:33 , Hebrews 1:5, and Hebrews 5:5
verses.8:
Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance,
 the ends of the earth Your possession.
verses.9:
You will break them + 2:9 LXX You will rule them or You will shepherd them with an iron scepter;
 You will shatter them like pottery. + 2:9 Cited in Revelation 2:27|REV 2:27 ; see also Revelation 12:5 and Revelation 19:15. ”
verses.10:
Therefore be wise, O kings;
 be admonished, O judges of the earth.
verses.11:
Serve the LORD with fear,
 and rejoice with trembling.
verses.12:
Kiss the Son, lest He be angry
 and you perish in your rebellion,
 when His wrath ignites in an instant.
 Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
